tema: The Hinterkaifeck murders, Germany's unsolved farm massacre
titulo: The Murderer Who Lived With His Victims
hook: Footsteps echoed from the attic, an unfamiliar newspaper appeared in the yard, and footprints led straight from the dark woods to an isolated Bavarian farm.
descricao: Six lives were taken on an isolated Bavarian farm, but the culprit did something even stranger after the slaughter. Why do you think the killer stayed behind to tend to the animals?

versoes.rascunho: Footprints led from the dark woods to the isolated Bavarian farm. What was waiting inside the house was far worse. In March 1922, Andreas Gruber noticed strange footsteps echoing from his attic. An unfamiliar newspaper appeared in the yard. Their terrified maid quit, claiming the house was haunted. Andreas ignored the warnings and refused to call the police. On Friday, a new maid named Maria arrived for her first day. That evening, silence fell over the farmstead. One by one, four family members were lured into the cold barn. A heavy iron mattock crushed their skulls in the dark. Inside the bedroom, Maria and two-year-old Josef died in their beds. Little seven-year-old Cäzilia survived for hours, tearing her hair out in the straw. Four long days passed before neighbors finally entered the quiet property. The killer had lived there with the six corpses for three whole days. He ate their food, lit fires in the hearth, and fed the cattle. The case was officially closed decades later, completely unsolved. Why would someone slaughter an entire family, yet stay to feed their livestock?
